name: Shidou Kazuomi
source:
The protagonist's classmate. He plays guitar in the band.
He has a bad habit of getting into fights all the time and not agreeing with his partners, so he quits the band.
He's the loner type who skips school and hangs out with other delinquents.
translation:
The protagonist's classmate. He plays guitar in the band.
He has a bad habit of getting into fights all the time and not agreeing with his partners, so he quits the band.
He's the loner type who skips school and hangs out with other delinquents.
